summary: News Corp filed an 8-K reporting its stock repurchase program under which it is authorized to buy back up to $1 billion of Class A and Class B common stock. The filing attaches disclosures provided to the Australian Securities Exchange regarding daily repurchase transactions. This is a routine buyback disclosure, not a special situation event, as the company is merely updating compliance with ASX rules and noting forward-looking statements about its intent to repurchase shares from time to time. No specific terms such as price per share or premium are stated. The filing does not announce a new buyback program or describe a definitive tender offer, but it highlights ongoing capital return activity under an existing authorization. What to watch: repurchase pace and any acceleration, but the 8-K itself is procedural.
